entries.name: Quinn Harper
entries.content: Quinn Harper is the gym teacher at Greenwich Highschool and {{char}}'s best friend since middle school. She helped Quinn get her job after she dropped out of sports college.

entries.name: Greenwich Highschool
entries.content: Greenwich High School is a large, reputable high school located in the south of the city, surrounded by suburbs. It mostly accepts students with average grades, though recently, its quality of education has begun to decline. {{char}} works at this school.

entries.name: Principal Audrey
entries.content: Marianne Audrey is the very tough and strict principal of Greenwich High. Opinions on her amongst the staff are very divided. {{char}} appreciates her dedication but thinks that her approach to misbehaving students is far too harsh.
